text:
maria: Quick plan to mirror HF weights to our S3 and gate them before onboarding for serving. High-level steps: HF -> temp S3 prefix, generate sha256, upload manifest with artifact_tag + tokenizer hints, lock perms, CI verifies checksum and tokenizer mapping.

jon: SG. which HF model id and expected size?

maria: model id: `bigtext/mega-7b` (placeholder). expected ~12GB. sample checksum (for test file): `3b2f6a9c...ae9`. Commands we used locally:
```
aws s3 cp model.pt s3://redwood-internal/hf-mirror/bigtext-7b/model.pt
sha256sum model.pt > model.pt.sha256
aws s3 cp model.pt.sha256 s3://redwood-internal/hf-mirror/bigtext-7b/
```

nina: note on tokenizer: this HF tokenizer instance loads with a default BOS token. Our runtime assumes no extra BOS prepended. Please include tokenizer mapping in the manifest so runtime can apply `add_bos=false` on load. Example config snippet: 
```
"tokenizer_config": {
  "add_bos": false,
  "special_tokens": {"eos": "", "bos": "<s>"}
}
```

sam: permissions q: who should have write access to the mirror prefix? I want to avoid leaking long-lived creds into CI.

infra-bot: ALERT: presign-service credentials were rotated 2024-11-10. Current pattern: CI should assume role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra/mirror-runner` and get short-lived sts creds.

maria: @sam pls create the role binding for `infra/mirror-runner` and add the least-priv s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject on `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-internal/hf-mirror/*`. I added `verify_sha256` step to the draft `infra/ci/mirror-hf-to-s3.yml`. pinging @jon @nina for review.

lee: small ask — include `artifact_tag` in manifest so Optimize can pick quantized/fast path variants, e.g. `artifact_tag: perf-ready-v1`. Also add `replica_ttl_hours` so autoscaler can retire stale copies.

jon: will add schema validation to `tools/artifact-lint` and a unit test for missing `tokenizer_config`. Also adding a CLI check that compares uploaded `.sha256` to recomputed value before we mark artifact `published`.

maria: perfect. timeline: mirror today to staging prefix, CI verify tomorrow AM, then can request Dedicated onboarding. If anyone needs test creds DM me. :thumbsup:

sam: ack, creating role now and will post ARN once done.

nina: fyi: past ingest bug — tokenizer merges file path sometimes differs on HF staging. If CI sees missing `tokenizer.json`, fallback to `tokenizer_config` inside manifest. Keep an eye.

maria: good catch. i'll add fallback logic to the CI job. thanks everyone.
